log_file.description: Log to this file instead of syslog (global `log file`).

modules.description: The modules (shares) the daemon exports: name, path, comment, read_only, list, use_chroot, uid, gid, timeout, and optionally max_connections, auth_users, secrets_file, hosts_allow, hosts_deny — rsyncd.conf(5). The default is the package's example module.

motd_file.description: File whose contents are shown to clients connecting (global `motd file`).

pid_file.description: Write the daemon's PID here (global `pid file`); leave unset under systemd.

syslog_facility.description: Syslog facility for the daemon's messages (default daemon).
